name: Alpha Addons for Gravity Forms
author: PluginsCafe

sections.description:
Enhance your Gravity Forms with powerful advanced addons, custom fields, and seamless integrations. Unlock greater flexibility, improved user experience, and smarter form functionality with ease.

🌟 Key Fields & Features

  • Star Rating Field
  • Notification Attachment
  • Tooltips
  • Limit Checkbox
  • Disable Entry Creation
  • Custom CSS & JS
  • Preview Submission
  • Klaviyo (CRM)
  • Google Calendar
  • Google Sheet
  • Cloudflare Turnstile
  • hCaptcha
  • Math Captcha
  • Read Only

  1. Star Rating Field
    Add the ability to add multiple Star Rating fields to Gravity Forms easily with various design settings/options.

  2. Notification Attachment
    Easily attach any file type to your notifications. Once activated, you’ll see an attachment button at the bottom of the notification settings. Click to attach your files.

  3. Tooltips
    When the Tooltips addon is activated, a tooltip text box will appear in each Gravity Forms field. Just enter your text, save the form, and it will display on the frontend.

  4. Limit Checkbox
    When the Limit Checkbox addon is active, a new option will appear in the checkbox field to set a selection limit. Simply set the number, and users will only be able to select up to that limit.

  5. Disable Entry Creation
    Disable entry creation for specific forms. This is useful when you want to use Gravity Forms for other purposes, such as email notifications or custom processing.

  6. Custom CSS & JS
    Custom CSS & JS allows you to store and apply custom styles and scripts for specific Gravity Forms. It helps tailor form behavior and design without affecting other forms or your theme.

  7. Preview Submission
    Preview Submission lets users review all entered form data before final submission, reducing errors and improving accuracy.

  8. Klaviyo (CRM)
    Integrate with Klaviyo to send form submissions to your Klaviyo account. This is useful when you want to use Klaviyo to send marketing emails to your subscribers.

  9. Google Calendar
    With Gravity Forms submissions, the submitted data is sent to Google Calendar, helping you organize events, meetings, and reminders all in one place.

  10. Google Sheet
    All Gravity Forms field data will be sent to Google Sheets according to the user’s configuration upon form submission.

  11. Cloudflare Turnstile
    Turnstile helps protect websites from bots and automated abuse (like spam form submissions or automated sign‑ups) while keeping the experience smooth for real users.

  12. hCaptcha
    hCaptcha is a privacy‑aware CAPTCHA solution that helps block bots and abuse while keeping user experience smoother and data protection stronger compared to some traditional CAPTCHA systems.

  13. Math Captcha
    Math CAPTCHA is a type of CAPTCHA that asks users to solve a simple mathematical problem (like addition, subtraction, or multiplication) to verify that they are human.

  14. Read Only
    Read Only allows you to make fields read-only, which means users cannot modify them. This is useful when you want to use Gravity Forms for other purposes, such as email notifications or custom processing.

Requirements

  • PHP 7.4+
  • Gravity Forms
sections.installation:
1. Install Alpha Addons for Gravity Forms plugin.
  2. Make sure you also have Gravity Forms activated.
